vanderbilt: Create a photorealistic colour photograph of an older man, approximately 60–70, in a vertical, chest-up studio portrait. He has an elongated oval face, a very high, broad, balding forehead, rounded cheeks, a substantial rounded chin, and a softly squared jaw. His eyes are narrow, deep-set, and hooded. The nose is long and prominent, with a broad rounded tip and distinct nostril wings. Thin, firmly closed lips form a restrained, serious expression. Sparse, dark brown-and-grey hair sweeps loosely backward across the crown without a sharp part; longer, unruly curls spread around the temples and ears. Bushy grey sideburns descend along the cheeks toward the jaw; the upper lip and chin are shaved. Dress him in mid-nineteenth-century formalwear: black broad-lapelled coat, white high standing collar, white shirtfront, and a voluminous black silk neckcloth. Use soft directional light from upper left, gentle right-side shadows, and a plain medium-grey backdrop. Preserve the original monochrome portrait’s fine grain, slightly softened edges, and sharply legible facial texture while rendering natural, subdued colour.

Preserve vintage portrait softness, fine grain, detailed facial texture, and restrained natural colour.
